root_cause.text: The ASoC STI uniperif player driver allocated `regmap_field` objects with `regmap_field_alloc()` during player initialization but never freed them on driver removal, causing a device-lifetime resource leak in `sound/soc/sti/uniperif_player.c`.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE/commit message explicitly says “The regmap_field objects allocated at player init are never freed and may leak resources if the driver is removed,” and the patch changes `player->clk_sel` and `player->valid_sel` from `regmap_field_alloc(regmap, regfield[n])` to `devm_regmap_field_alloc(&pdev->dev, regmap, regfield[n])` to bind their lifetime to the device.

agent_logs.root_cause_candidate: The ASoC STI uniperif player driver allocated `regmap_field` objects with `regmap_field_alloc()` during player initialization but never freed them on driver removal, causing a device-lifetime resource leak in `sound/soc/sti/uniperif_player.c`.
agent_logs.evidence_points: The CVE/commit message explicitly says “The regmap_field objects allocated at player init are never freed and may leak resources if the driver is removed,” and the patch changes `player->clk_sel` and `player->valid_sel` from `regmap_field_alloc(regmap, regfield[n])` to `devm_regmap_field_alloc(&pdev->dev, regmap, regfield[n])` to bind their lifetime to the device.

intent_record.intent_summary: Convert regmap field allocations to device-managed allocations to prevent resource leaks.
intent_record.what: The two calls that allocate regmap fields for `player->clk_sel` and `player->valid_sel` were changed from `regmap_field_alloc(regmap, ...)` to `devm_regmap_field_alloc(&pdev->dev, regmap, ...)`.
intent_record.how: The allocated regmap field resources are now device-managed, so they will be automatically released when the platform device is detached, instead of requiring explicit cleanup. This reduces the risk of resource leaks if probe succeeds or fails after allocation.

grouping_result.intent: Convert regmap field allocations to device-managed allocations to prevent resource leaks.

relevance_review.reason: The change directly addresses the reported device-lifetime leak by converting `regmap_field_alloc()` usage to device-managed allocations, which ensures the `regmap_field` objects are freed on driver removal.

candidates.rationale: This allocates a regmap_field object during player initialization without any matching free in the pre-fix code path, directly causing the device-lifetime resource leak.
This is the second regmap_field allocation performed at init time and, like the first, was not released on driver removal before the fix, contributing to the leak.

vuln_statements.explanation: This statement allocates a regmap_field during player initialization, and the pre-fix code had no corresponding free on driver removal, causing the device-lifetime resource leak.
This is the second regmap_field allocation performed during initialization; it also lacked a matching release before the fix, contributing to the same leak.
